text:
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued for release v2.14.0 -> prod. Change window 2026-03-20 22:00-02:00 UTC. Preflight prompt/eval suite ran — STATUS: WARNING. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/eval/1987654321 :eyes:

Maria: Preflight failing on the summarizer prompt-set. ROUGE-L down and hallucination tests regressed. Attaching short metric snapshot below.

qa-bot: ```
prompt_set: summarizer-suite
metric | baseline | candidate | delta
ROUGE-L | 0.412 | 0.384 | -6.8%
Hallucination-rate | 0.9% | 2.7% | +200%
Latency p95 | 180ms | 202ms | +12.2%
```

Sam: That's a sizable quality delta for a preflight. Any recent model weight or prompt-rewrite changes? :thinking_face:

Maria: Looks correlated with the new prompt-normalizer we enabled in the release (PR #4821). Several edge prompts truncate differently now; candidate tends to produce concise but missing key facts.

Kevin: We need an ops decision: do we pin to v2.13 behavior for the release (fast path) or block the promotion and triage? How long to fix?

Jordan: If we proceed without rollback/pin, we should enable automatic fallback to v2.13 for the first 10% traffic. But given hallucination jump, I lean toward blocking. Risk to customers > tolerance.

Alisa: Heads up — if we block the window, we should notify customers in the release channel and update the release notes. :loud_sound:

Sam: Repro steps posted to the bug: https://issue.redwood.internal/INC-2345. Hypothesis: prompt-normalizer latest commit changed stop-token stripping. Quick revert or config tweak could fix in ~1-2h if trivial. Bisect started.

Maria: QA recommendation: HOLD promotion until regression is addressed and preflight passes again. Blocking for safety.

Kevin: OK — blocking promotion for the window. Maria/Sam please prioritize triage. Alisa please prepare a short customer-facing status; Jordan and infra: prep bump path to enable fallback if we need to resume partial rollout.

deploy-bot: Action: promotion on hold. Canary paused and will not auto-promote. To resume, a manual /deploy-bot resume with a cleared preflight tag is required. Notifying #releases and required approvers.

Sam: Starting bisect now, will ping this thread with root cause or revert candidate. ETA first signal ~30-45m.

Maria: Adding temporary test cases to the suite to catch this class of stop-token truncation regressions. Also creating a pinned eval with failing examples for visibility.

Kevin: Thanks all. If bisect shows trivial revert, we'll aim for a hotfix and a re-run of preflight within the same window. If not, we keep block and reschedule. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:

Alisa: Noted. Preparing comms template now.

Jordan: Ops standing by for fallback toggles.

last update - Sam: bisect found PR #4821 as likely cause; creating revert PR #4823. Will run preflight on revert branch once CI passes.
